title: Kymenlaakso: 4.2 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €185,650 a year
markdown:
# Kymenlaakso: 4.2 more lung cancer patients a year treated to cure, for €185,650 a year

> Closes 4.2 of 9.1 missing patients a year (46%) · €185,650 of €1M · €814,350 left: nothing more pays off on today's evidence

## The gap

Of 100 lung cancer patients in Kymenlaakso, 19 get treatment that aims to cure. In Finland it is 27. That is about 9 patients a year. [^care_curative] Compared with the best quarter of counties, 13.1 patients a year are missing from treatment that aims to cure, with a range of 9.0 to 16.7. [^care_curative] [^model] Of the 9.1 patients a year missing compared with Finland as a whole, 7.3 are fewer patients operated and 1.8 are fewer given radiotherapy that aims to cure. [^care_curative] [^model]

## The target

Raise the share of lung cancer patients treated to cure from 19.3% to 22.8% by 2028: 4.2 more patients a year (range 0.0–6.1), for €185,650 a year, about €44,627 per extra patient. [^care_curative][^model] That closes 46% of the measured shortfall against Finland as a whole (9.1 patients a year). [^model]

## Funded actions

| # | Action and owner | Cost a year | More patients treated to cure a year (range) | First step this week | Measure: today → target |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| | **The county can start on Monday** | | | | |
| 1 | **Stereotactic radiotherapy pathway for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated**[^ev_sbrt_pathway_1]. Chief physician of oncology; chief of radiotherapy at the university hospital | €25,640 | 1.0 (0.0–1.9) | Write the referral rule: every stage I patient not accepted for surgery is referred for stereotactic radiotherapy the same week. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 19.3% → 20.1% by 2028 |
| 2 | **Travel and accommodation support for patients far from the university hospital**[^ev_travel_accommodation_support_1]. Chief physician of oncology and hospital social work; university hospital patient hotel | €36,460 | 0.4 (0.0–0.4) | Name one contact person who books the patient hotel and transport for every patient sent to the university hospital for curative treatment. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 19.3% → 19.7% by 2028 |
| 3 | **Fitness assessment and prehabilitation before deciding against curative treatment**[^ev_prehab_fitness_assessment_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; leads of rehabilitation and geriatrics | €31,550 | 0.3 (0.0–0.2) | Decide that no stage I-III patient is recorded as "not fit" without an exercise test, and book the physiotherapy group. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 19.3% → 19.5% by 2028 |
| | **Needs the collaborative area (university hospital)** | | | | |
| 4 | **Thoracic surgeon reviews every decision not to operate**[^ev_surgeon_second_opinion_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; chief of thoracic surgery at the university hospital | €41,000 | 1.4 (0.0–2.8) | Agree with the university hospital that a thoracic surgeon joins the weekly lung meeting, and send last quarter's stage I-II patients who were not operated for a second look. | Share of patients operated: 8.8% → 10.0% by 2028 |
| 5 | **Video MDT review of every stage I-III patient with the university hospital**[^ev_video_mdt_stage1_3_1]. Chief physician of pulmonology; lead of the university hospital lung MDT | €51,000 | 1.1 (0.0–1.2) | Ask the university hospital for a fixed weekly video slot and list every stage I-III patient diagnosed last month who was not discussed there. | Share of patients who get treatment that aims to cure: 19.3% → 20.3% by 2028 |
| | **Total** | **€185,650** | **4.2 (0.0–6.1)** | | |

No trial has measured these effects; the low end of every range is zero. The ranges do not add up to the range of the total, because the measures share one ceiling. Costs are assumptions. [^model]

## Needs a national decision (outside this budget)

- **Low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers**[^ev_ldct_screening_1]: Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). €488,594 a year; modelled to avoid 0.8 deaths a year (0.2–2.1). Not counted in this budget. Not a county decision. Ask the Ministry and Palko for the timetable after the 2026-2028 pilot and offer the county as a pilot site. [^model]

## What to measure from Monday

- Share of patients treated to cure: 19.3% (2019–2023, measured) → 22.8% by 2028. [^care_curative][^model]
- Share of patients operated: 8.8% → 10.0% by 2028. [^care_surgery][^model]
- The registry's public figures cover 2019–2023; count these each month from the county's own records. [^care_curative]

## What more money buys, and what it cannot

In the model, the remaining €814,350 buys nothing more toward treatment that aims to cure: these measures are limited by the reachable part of the measured shortfall, not by money. [^model] To see what else the money could do, look at low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision and cannot be bought from a county budget, or rank measures by deaths avoided instead. [^model] Lung cancer causes about 95 deaths a year in Kymenlaakso; this plan is modelled to avoid 0.6 of them a year. [^deaths] [^model]

## Pilot ask

Six-month pilot: surgeon review + radiotherapy referral. The two actions model 2.4 extra patients/year and 21.3% treated to cure by 2028. Six months cannot show the share moving; it can show the pathway work. [^model]

## Limits

- Effects are ranges, not probabilities: the lowest and highest values when every assumed effect moves together. No trial has measured them, and each could be zero. [^model]
- The comparison with the expected share is adjusted only for residents' age, not for stage at diagnosis, other illness, smoking or completeness of recording. County figures cannot show cause. [^model]
- The symptom-to-treatment clock is estimated, not measured: in a check, 0 of 3 measured outcomes matched it beyond chance. [^model]

removed.sentence: The estimated symptom-to-treatment clock is not used in this plan: in a check, 0 of 3 measured outcomes matched it beyond chance.
removed.reason: The clause 'is not used in this plan' is not in the material. The material only says the clock is a secondary, estimated view. That clause was cut and replaced with the supported wording 'is estimated, not measured'. The rest of the sentence stands.

flagged.sentence: The remaining €814,350 buys nothing more toward treatment that aims to cure: these measures are limited by the reachable part of the measured shortfall, not by money.
flagged.reason: This is a model result stated as fact. The material says it 'buys nothing more in the model', so 'In the model' was added.

flagged.sentence: More could come from low-dose CT screening for long-term heavy smokers, which needs a national decision, or from ranking measures by deaths avoided instead.
flagged.reason: This implied the remaining money could produce more curative treatment, which the material does not support. Deaths-objective measures do not change who is treated to cure, and screening cannot be bought from a county budget. It was rewritten to match the material's 'to see what else the money could do'.

flagged.sentence: Shares are adjusted only for residents' age, not for stage at diagnosis, other illness, smoking or completeness of recording.
flagged.reason: The measured shares are not adjusted. Only the expected share used for comparison is adjusted for age. The sentence was rewritten to say this correctly.
